items.title: Ken Poston interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, June 4, 2024
items.q: here’s Stan Kenton and you kind of get to play with him ‘cause he’s playing the piano while you’re playing

ctx.x: Yeah. Stan didn’t swing you know.

No. And there’s not much in between you know it’s either — and I remember my dad, I mean one of the things growing up I think that probably interested me in the music was my dad came from the swing era, and he had all the records and you know he loved the big bands. So I grew up hearing those bands. And when I started to play the trumpet in I don’t know fifth grade, sixth grade, whenever you start doing that, I would — probably to please my dad, not that he insisted on that, but I thought it was fun to — he loved…

I had the same experience, you know at SUNY Fredonia. He came there and I was star- struck and I kept thinking that’s what I want to do. I want to be in a band like that. And as it turns out, you know, I’m more of a Basie guy. But still, there’s nothing like that. I’m wondering if, in all your research that you’ve done about different people, especially on the West Coast, and you read what other people write about them, and then you get to know the actual person and you have conversations about them. Have you…
